# 130 — PR explainer (HIGH tier)

## Goal
Stop the pool-detail hero badge from mislabeling stablecoin-lending pools as **"YIELD FARMING"**. Rendered audit (2026-07-24) caught SUSDS on `sky-lending` and `venus-core-pool` (BSC, $268M TVL) both wearing the wrong badge — a trust mismatch for the cautious-saver ICP on the exact page the north star measures (pool-detail conversion clicks).

## Intuition
There were **two** pool-type classifiers that had drifted apart:
- `app.js`'s `getPoolType` — the complete one (5 category lists, RWA/Yield-Derivatives-aware, `venus`/`moonwell` already covered). The analytics grid used this, so the grid was correct.
- `PoolDetail.js`'s inline `getPoolType` — a narrower hand-copy (`aave/compound/morpho/spark/maple/euler/radiant` only, no RWA/YD). The pool-detail badge used this, so it mislabeled everything the narrow list missed.

Two copies of the same logic is the bug generator. The fix is to have **one** classifier and make both surfaces call it.

## What changed and why
1. **`PoolDetail.js` becomes the single source.** It loads before `app.js` (home.html guarantees `PoolDetail.compiled.min.js` executes first — already relied on, since app.js references the global `PoolDetail`). A top-level `function getPoolTypeShared(pool)` (the complete app.js logic verbatim) plus the 5 list constants now live here. Top-level function declarations are cross-script globals and terser preserves their names (`mangle:true`, no `toplevel:true`) — same mechanism that keeps `PoolDetail` global.
2. **`'sky-lending'` added to `LENDING_PROTOCOLS`** — the one genuine coverage gap (SUSDS). `venus`/`moonwell`/`benqi-lending` were already present, so simply routing pool-detail through the complete list fixes them for free.
3. **`app.js` delegates.** Its 5 list constants (used only inside `getPoolType`) and the classifier body are deleted; `const getPoolType = (pool) => getPoolTypeShared(pool);` replaces them. All 5 grid call-sites are unchanged and now share the identical logic — proven unchanged by `test_category_taxonomy.js`.
4. **Compiled + minified outputs regenerated** (`npm run compile && npm run minify`) — home.html ships `*.compiled.min.js`, so source-only edits would not reach production.
5. **`test_pool_type_badge.js`** (new, fixture-routed Playwright on the real `/?pool=<id>` render) asserts the badge textContent for 5 pools; added to the `npm test` chain.

## Diff in reading order
- `PoolDetail.js`: +list constants +`getPoolTypeShared` (top level); inline `getPoolType` deleted; render uses `getPoolTypeShared(pool)`.
- `app.js`: list constants + `getPoolType` body deleted; one-line delegation added.
- `PoolDetail.compiled.js` / `.min.js`, `app.compiled.js` / `.min.js`: regenerated build outputs.
- `package.json`: `test` script appends `&& node test_pool_type_badge.js`.
- `test_pool_type_badge.js`: new acceptance test.
- `product-loop-kit/`: `specs/130.md`, `-notes.md`, this file, BACKLOG status, LOG entry.

## Deviations from spec
None functional. One documented **pre-existing** failure left untouched (fixing it would be scope creep): `test_minified_assets.js`'s "plan.html loads raw planner.js" assertion fails identically on `origin/main` — item 130 touches neither plan.html nor planner.js.

## Acceptance evidence
- `test_pool_type_badge.js` — 10/10 (susds→Lending, venus→Lending, aave→Lending, pendle→Yield Derivatives, farm→Yield Farming; zero page errors on each render). Re-run independently: EXIT 0.
- `test_category_taxonomy.js` — 8/8 unit + 5/5 rendered (grid classification unchanged).
- Trust rails untouched (APY_SANITY_LIMIT / DEFAULT_MIN_TVL / anomaly / haircut).
